main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on forecast (forecast > 0)

statistic.name: slope t, residuals summed per day (day-clustered)

main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 (with top-fifth mean > 0); reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return, top fifth of forecast by coin

decided_by: Confirm: the slope's t is 2 or more and the top-fifth mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Excess = next-day close-to-close return minus the coin's mean 1-day return over all its windows; the slope's t uses day-clustered standard errors (each day's score summed across coins); the top fifth is the coin's cases with forecast at or above its 80th percentile, pooled across coins; a 'down-day case' is a bar with forecast > 0 and a next-day return in the same window.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0002362 on the check folds against +0.0003977 on every fold
